title: Doctor's remaining per-item checks still grow faster than linearly with work items and memories
outcome: Doctor's remaining per-item checks still grow faster than linearly with work items and memories
acceptance: A measurement names the checks behind whole-doctor growth past the full-text checks (9000 work items 8.6 s, 9000 memories 5.0 s on synthetic stores after the full-text fix) and either fixes the superlinear ones with a measured before/after or records why each is bounded
